name: qiaomu-opencli-browser
title_zh: 让 AI 用你已登录的 Chrome 操作任意网页
tagline_zh: 不用 API key、不用重登账号，AI 直接接管你开着的浏览器：导航、点击、输入、抓取、等待，全自动。
tagline_en: No API key, no re-login. AI takes over your open Chrome to navigate, click, type, extract, and wait — fully.
desc_en: Make websites accessible for AI agents. Navigate, click, type, extract, wait — using Chrome with existing login sessions. No LLM API key needed.
why_zh: 复用现有登录态，绕开验证码和权限墙；本地驱动 Chrome，数据不出机器，比云端浏览器方案更隐私可控。
why_en: Reuses live sessions, bypassing logins and CAPTCHAs; drives Chrome locally, so data stays on your machine — more private and.
limit_zh: 只认本机已装的 Chrome（含调试端口），且页面必须是标准 DOM；遇到 iframe 嵌套或 Shadow DOM。
limit_en: Requires local Chrome with debug port; only standard DOM works — iframes and Shadow DOM slip through, and hard CAPTCHAs still need a human.
